caveats: Claims are frozen at snapshot time and never edited; every snapshot ships with a SHA-256 hash over its canonical claim JSON.

Failures and censored cases are published alongside successes — no cherry-picking. Resolution rules were registered before the first snapshot (docs/TRACK_RECORD_PRERULE.md) and are not changed retroactively for open claims.
Base rates are shown next to results — a hit rate without its base rate is marketing, not evidence.
Negative gate verdicts (features we tested and did NOT ship) are a permanent part of this record.
Tracking starts 08/2026 — there is no retroactive back-fill of claims that were never frozen.

level_up.success_rule: peak minute-weighted season level ≥ conf_strength + 0.05 with ≥ 400 min, within 4 seasons

weekly_boards.rule: one frozen board state per ISO week (first write wins); hashes re-verified at every publish; weekly states prove rankings were never retro-edited and inherit the claim-class resolution rules (TRACK_RECORD_PRERULE §4)

gate_history.name: Level-Up flag (▲) backtest
gate_history.result: Flagged (pred_climb ≥ 0.08): 31.6% climbed ≥ +0.05 within 4 seasons vs. 3.9% unflagged (~8×). Spearman(pred, realized) = 0.30; calibration monotone in both directions. Age is a multiplier (flag + age < 23 → 45.1%).

gate_history.name: Riser flag (momentum signal)
gate_history.result: Pre-registered kill rule hit (p ≤ 0.05 AND uplift ≥ +3.0pp AND both split halves positive — not all met). No export, no frontend element.

gate_history.name: Team-relative style stats (scheme correction)
gate_history.result: Pre-registered premise test (n = 2,273 NCAA→Europe transitions): team-relative college rates predicted the first pro season consistently slightly WORSE than raw rates (steals Δρ = −0.024, 95% CI entirely below zero). A second registered pass with sharper instruments (T1b: residual bias test, leave-one-out baseline, extreme-scheme slice, regression form) confirmed the negative — the hypothesized direction appears as a non-significant whisper, and every correction predicts worse than the raw stat. No model feature; the descriptive system-context view is unaffected (facts, not predictions).

gate_history.name: Front-office Tilt × Sharpe (regime returns)
gate_history.result: T3 split-half ρ = −0.44 (threshold ≥ 0.5), T1 p = 0.20 — regime-level return claims not supported (third negative confirmation at regime level).

gate_history.name: Coach scheme portability (system-context projection)
gate_history.result: Pre-registered test of whether a team's style profile travels with the coach across D1 jobs (235 moves, 2010–2026): mean Spearman ρ across the 6 pre-named style axes = 0.34 [0.28, 0.39], permutation p = 0.0002 — both fixed thresholds met (ρ ≥ 0.20, p ≤ 0.05). Licenses ONE thing: the descriptive system-context card may forward-project an incoming coach's prior-job profile, labeled as a projection. No model feature (team-relative rates remain gated out per TEAM_REL_PRERULE).
